text:
21 hours ago 🏛️ Brookings County Commission: Claims, Staffing & Humane Society
The Brookings County Commission held its regular meeting on Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. All five commissioners – Shawn Hostler, Kelly VanderWal, Larry Jensen, Doug Post, and Dave Miller – were present. The meeting opened with the Pledge of Allegiance .
Agenda & Public Comments
Commissioners approved the meeting agenda and then opened the floor for citizen comments.
• Clint Hoyer , a candidate for District 8 Senate , introduced himself to the board.
• Angie Daly , a Brookings County resident and member of the Brookings Regional Humane Society Board, presented 2025 animal shelter data:
745 animals were taken in.
653 animals were adopted into new homes.
Some animals had to be put down because of the condition they were in when they arrived.
She explained that most of the group’s income comes from donations, fundraisers, and adoption fees , and that this largely covers labor costs. She also read their mission statement: “ To improve the lives of companion animals and support the people who care for them. ”
Consent Agenda: Minutes, Travel, Personnel
The commission approved the consent agenda , which included:
• Minutes from the September 1, 2026 commission meeting.
• Travel & Education Requests for staff:
Richard Haugen to attend Emergency Management Crisis Track Training on Sept 21 in Sioux Falls .
Sonia Mack to attend SDSU Extension Fall Conference Sept 21–23 in Aberdeen .
Andrew Foreman to attend NCIC Full Access Certification training Oct 5–8 in Pierre .
Don Nordbye and Kristen Witchey to attend the 2026 Annual Safety & Loss Control Training Conference Nov 4–5 in Pierre .
• Personnel changes (mostly routine pay adjustments and one resignation):
Amanda Hensen to $26.14/hour , effective Sept 3, 2026 .
Bryan Smith to $27.49/hour , effective Sept 5, 2026 (annual review).
Diane Spencer hired as a Temporary Election Worker at $18.06/hour , effective Sept 22, 2026 .
Jack Thompson to $29.17/hour , effective Oct 1, 2026 (annual review).
Amanda Hansen voluntary resignation without notice, effective Sept 3, 2026 .
Approval of Claims (Bills Paid)
Commissioners also approved a long list of claims (bills) for county operations. These covered many areas, including:
• Office and copier contracts, utilities, and phone service
• Fuel and maintenance for patrol and county vehicles
• Road and bridge work, including:
Bowes Construction for asphalt, gravel, and Samara Avenue work: $779,541.22
Banner Associates for Medary Bridge design at Oak Lake: $12,114.00
Hollaway Bridge And Culvert for culvert replacement and grading: $93,745.08
• Courthouse and building work, such as courthouse bat mitigation ( $14,073.96 ) and cupola restoration design ( $2,250.00 )
• Jail inmate meals ( $19,531.32 ) and medications ( $4,922.33 )
• Court-appointed attorney fees
• Training, conferences, and jury-related costs
All claims were approved on a roll call vote , with every commissioner voting “aye.”
